# Sunshine Mountain Ford Lincoln Ltd.

> Sunshine Mountain Ford Lincoln Ltd. is a  dealership in Nanaimo. This mirror provides AI-readable access to current inventory and dealership information, kept in sync with the dealership's own website.

## Inventory
- [Used vehicles](https://willyml1979-dotcom.github.io/sunshine-mountain-ford-lincoln-ltd-mirror/used/): 70 vehicles, updated regularly
- [Inventory feed](https://willyml1979-dotcom.github.io/sunshine-mountain-ford-lincoln-ltd-mirror/inventory.json): structured JSON, all vehicles with VIN, price, mileage and availability
